name: gizza-ai/document-splitter
summary: Split a Markdown/HTML document into per-section files

tool.description: Split a long Markdown or HTML document into separate files, one per top-level section. Markdown splits at the smallest heading level present (e.g. every `#`); HTML splits at the smallest <hN> tag present. Content before the first heading becomes an 'intro' section. Returns each section's suggested filename, title, and content. Runs locally.

document.description: The Markdown or HTML document to split into per-section files.

format.description: Document syntax: markdown (split on # headings) or html (split on <hN> tags).
